data.name: Ayyash
data.gender_notes: Ayyash is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ayyas' meaning strong, steadfast. The name Ayyash carries the meaning “Strong, steadfast” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ayyash usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who embodies courage, wisdom and strength
data.etymology: Ayyash belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, steadfast.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayyash total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ayyash" carries a significant cultural impact as it symbolizes strength and steadfastness. This name would have been highly valued in ancient Arab societies where these attributes were essential for survival. In contemporary society, this name would still be held in high regard as a symbol of resilience and unwavering loyalty.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name "Ayyash" embodies the innate human qualities of courage, endurance, and commitment to one's faith and values. It is a reminder that, no matter what challenges life may present, one can remain steadfast and true to their beliefs. The name also echoes the story of Prophet Yunus (Jonah), who was called "Ayyub" (Job) after his unwavering patience during hardships. Thus, the spiritual significance of the name "Ayyash" is one of perseverance, strength, and unyielding faith in the face of adversity.
